p: Have they brought provisions with them,
There is pestilence among the pigs.
Rav Yehuda decreed a fast. … Let us say … Rav Yehuda maintains
Rav Yehuda decreed a fast. The Gemara asks: Let us say that Rav Yehuda maintains
a plague affecting one species … affect all species, … No, … pigs are different,
a plague affecting one species will come to affect all species, and that is why he decreed a fast. The Gemara answers: No, in other cases there is no cause for concern. However, pigs are different,
as their intestines are similar to … humans.
as their intestines are similar to those of humans.
